about.why: The paragraph a devotee reads before deciding to give.

accounting_basis.label: Cash or accrual basis
accounting_basis.why: Decides when income is recognised. Changing it later restates every statement.

address.label: Full address
address.why: Required on an 80G receipt for it to be valid.

area.label: Locality / area
area.why: What devotees search accommodation by — “Palitana”, not just the city.

bank_account_name.label: Account holder name
bank_account_name.why: What a donor must type as the beneficiary, or the transfer bounces.

cash_bank_account.label: At least one cash or bank account
cash_bank_account.why: Every receipt is posted against an account; without one nothing can be recorded.

categories.label: Donation categories
categories.why: Lets you report on what the money was given for.

comms_templates.label: Review your message templates
comms_templates.why: Check what goes out in your name before a donor reads it.

contact.label: Phone and email
contact.why: How a donor reaches you about their receipt.

darshan_timings.label: Darshan timings
darshan_timings.why: Stops the phone calls asking when you open.

expense_heads.label: Expense heads
expense_heads.why: Without them every expense lands in one bucket and the I&E statement says nothing.

gallery.label: Photos of your temple
gallery.why: A page with no photographs gets scrolled past.

gstin.label: GSTIN
gstin.why: Shown on invoices where GST is charged.

links.label: Website or social links
links.why: Where a devotee goes to see more of your work.

logo.label: Trust logo
logo.why: Makes a receipt recognisably yours. Optional but recommended.

main_deity.label: Mulnayak / main deity
main_deity.why: The first thing a Jain devotee looks for when choosing a temple to visit.

map_pin.label: Map pin
map_pin.why: Puts a Directions button on your temple page in the devotee app.

my_account.label: Your own name on your account
my_account.why: Signs the entries you record and appears in the activity log.

name.label: Trust/Temple name
name.why: The name donors see on their receipt.

numbering.label: Receipt numbering series
numbering.why: Gapless numbering is what an auditor checks first.

opening_balances.label: Opening balances on your accounts
opening_balances.why: Without them your cash book starts at zero and never agrees with the tin.

pan.label: Trust PAN
pan.why: Printed on 80G receipts and required for Form 10BD.

payment_details.label: UPI or bank details for donors
payment_details.why: Shown to devotees paying you directly, and printed on receipts.

payment_modes.label: Payment modes
payment_modes.why: Cash, UPI, cheque, bank — how a receipt records the way money arrived.

pincode.label: PIN code
pincode.why: Part of the address on statutory receipts.

prasad_items.label: Add prasad items and prices
prasad_items.why: The counter cannot sell an empty catalogue.

receipt_footer.label: Receipt footer note
receipt_footer.why: Your thank-you line, or the declaration your auditor wants on every receipt.

reg_80g.label: 80G registration number
reg_80g.why: The number that lets a donor claim the deduction.

rooms.label: Add rooms with tariffs
rooms.why: No booking can be taken until at least one room exists.

seva_types.label: Set up your seva list and rates
seva_types.why: Replace the samples with the sevas this trust actually offers.

staff.label: Invite at least one more user
staff.why: So the trust does not depend on a single person's phone.

template.label: Receipt template chosen
template.why: Pick the layout donors will receive.

trustees.label: Add your trustees
trustees.why: Shown on the public profile and used on certificates.

upi_qr.label: UPI QR code
upi_qr.why: A devotee scans instead of typing your UPI id — fewer wrong transfers.

issue.FORMAT_pan: PAN is 10 characters: five letters, four digits, one letter (e.g. AAATR1234C).
issue.FORMAT_gstin: GSTIN is 15 characters: state code, the PAN, an entity number, Z and a check character (e.g. 27AAATR1234C1Z0).
issue.FORMAT_tan: TAN is 10 characters: four letters, five digits, one letter (e.g. MUMT12345A).
issue.FORMAT_fssai_license: An FSSAI licence or registration number is 14 digits.
issue.FORMAT_urn: Enter the 16-character URN from the Income Tax approval (e.g. AAATR1234CF20214). It starts with the trust's PAN.
issue.PLACEHOLDER: "{{value}}" is not a registration number. Leave the box empty if the trust does not have one.
issue.STATE_CODE: A GSTIN starts with a state code (01–38); "{{code}}" is not one.
issue.CHECKSUM: This GSTIN fails its check character. Please look for a typo.
issue.PAN_MISMATCH: This number was issued to PAN {{inner}}, but the trust's PAN is {{pan}}. It must be the trust's own registration.

designer.heading: Your own receipt designs
designer.subheading: Build a receipt the way your trust wants it. A design prints only after the JainERP team has approved it.
designer.empty: You have not built a design yet. Start one, or keep using the ready-made designs on the Receipts tab.
designer.name: Name this design
designer.docKindLocked: Locked once saved — start a new design for a different document.
designer.blocksHint: Drag order with the arrows. Remove anything you do not want — a few parts a receipt must carry cannot be removed.
designer.titleHint: Leave blank to use the standard name for each document.
designer.ownLinePlaceholder: Jai Jinendra! Thank you for your generous daan.
designer.noMarkupHint: Plain text only. Set it once per language — a language you leave blank uses your English line.
designer.previewHint: Exactly what will print, drawn by the same renderer.
designer.submitted: Sent. You will see it here once it is reviewed.
designer.confirmSubmit: The JainERP team will review it. You can keep using your current receipts until it is approved.
designer.newVersion: Started version {{version}}. Your approved design keeps printing until this one is approved.
designer.approvalNote: Nothing prints until it is approved.
designer.rejectedHeading: Changes needed before this can be approved
designer.pendingHeading: This design is with the JainERP team. It cannot be edited while it is being reviewed — start a new version if you need to change it.
designer.frozenPending: This design is waiting for approval, so it cannot be edited. Start a new version to make changes — the design you print today is unaffected.
designer.frozenApproved: This design is approved and printing, so it cannot be edited in place. Start a new version to make changes; this one keeps printing until the new one is approved.
designer.wordingElsewhere: Every other printed word is changed under Wording, which applies to all designs at once and needs no approval.
